edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC5 Disallowed transition refused
    Given the model does not allow the status change the user asks for on the open deviation
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then the system refuses the change with MSG-GEN-001
    And nothing changes and no record is written

  Scenario: AC6 Access refused reads nothing
    Given the role does not hold the case record right U
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then the system answers 403 with MSG-P4-002 and reads no deviation
    And nothing changes and no record is written

  Scenario: AC7 Schema boundary refused at build
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a v_ace_* view, a recovery_case row or another service's schema
    When the boundary test runs on the build
    Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails
    And nothing is released

  Scenario: AC8 Business rules covered
    Given the rules BR1 to BR10 of section 8
    When the tests of section 16 run
    Then each rule is exercised by a test of section 16 or is held as an architecture constraint

  Scenario: AC9 Error answers
    Given the provided operations of this story
    When a request has no valid credential, no right on the case, or names a deviation that does not exist
    Then the system answers 401, 403 or 404 as the error set of RWB-S8-E7008-CON defines, with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC10 Replay with the same outcome
    Given the same review of the deviation with the same outcome is already recorded
    When the same review is sent again
    Then one record exists and the answer is the record that exists

  Scenario: AC11 Package read timeout
    Given the rwb-decision package read does not answer inside 2 s
    When the review step runs
    Then the step retries on the workflow's own schedule, nothing is written and the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope
BR14 AC1 (X6). BR1 to BR10 are also covered by AC8 and TC-E7-008-11.
